<function name="IsWater" parent="SurfaceInfo" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Checks if the brush surface is water.

<note>This internally checks the SURFDRAW_WATER flag.</note>
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Returns true if the surface is water.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
